headline: Champions League: Silva sparks Real Madrid’s demolition of Leipzig as Lask stun Sporting
standfirst: Bernardo Silva opens scoring as Madrid win 4-1 Galatasaray sweep past Lille; 10-man Inter edge Shakhtar Real Madrid claimed a third Champions League victory in as many games by thrashing RB Leipzig 4-1 on Wednesday…
body_markdown:
Bernardo Silva opens scoring as Madrid win 4-1 Galatasaray sweep past Lille; 10-man Inter edge Shakhtar Real Madrid claimed a third Champions League victory in as many games by thrashing RB Leipzig 4-1 on Wednesday, with Kylian Mbappé and Yan Diomande among the goals for José Mourinho’s side. Bernardo Silva opened the scoring for Madrid from close range towards the end of a tight first half, with Arda Guler doubling the record 15-time European champions’ advantage soon after the interval. (The Guardian Sport)

**Vanguard** adds: Real Madrid claimed a third Champions League victory in as many games by thrashing RB Leipzig 4-1 on Wednesday, with Kylian Mbappe and Yan Diomande among the goals for Jose Mourinho’s side. Bernardo Silva opened the scoring for Madrid from close range towards the end of a tight first half, with Arda Guler doubling the record 15-time European champions’ advantage soon after the interval.

**France 24** adds: Real Madrid thrashed RB Leipzig 4-1 on Wednesday to secure their third consecutive Champions League victory. Bernardo Silva, Arda Guler, Kylian Mbappe and Yan Diomande scored for Jose Mourinho’s side, while Tidiam Gomis replied for Leipzig.

**BBC Sport** adds: Real Madrid maintain their 100 per cent start in the Champions League as they comfortably beat Leipzig 4-1, with Bernardo Silva scoring his first goal for Madrid since moving from Manchester City in the summer.

**Al Jazeera** adds: Kylian Mbappe and Yan Diomande score stunners as Real beat Leipzig to make it three from three in the Champions League.

This digest was assembled automatically from reporting by France 24, The Guardian Sport, BBC Sport, Al Jazeera and Vanguard. Follow the source links below for the full coverage.
